messages.content: Which planet has rings around it with a name starting with letter S?

message.content: Saturn is the planet with rings around it whose name starts with the letter **S**. It's the most famous ringed planet in our solar system, known for its prominent and beautiful system of icy rings. (While Jupiter, Uranus, and Neptune also have rings, Saturn is the one whose name begins with S.)
